integrity: A standalone finite checker supplements a uniform integral proof; the checker is not a substitute for the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to ordinary three-cut complexes of the indicated Möbius ladders for n>=5 and the specified dihedral action. No integral representation decomposition or independent mathematical audit; equivalent unindexed literature cannot be excluded.
title: Dihedral homology characters of Möbius-ladder three-cut complexes
